note: Single source of truth for review categories, resolutions, and statuses. Imported by both the dashboard (TS) and the pipeline scripts (mjs).

shared-alias.label: Shared aliases
shared-alias.hint: One alias resolves to more than one player. Never auto-merge.

merge-candidate.label: Merge candidates
merge-candidate.hint: Distinct players share a messenger id / email. Review before any merge.

name-duplicate.label: Name-only duplicates
name-duplicate.hint: Matching names alone are LOW-confidence evidence.

championship.label: Championships
championship.hint: Do not auto-promote heuristic champions to verified.

historical-note.label: Historical notes
historical-note.hint: Administrative annotations (e.g. EGO Season 1 seeding). Do not rewrite brackets.

entry-method.label: Entry method
entry-method.hint: Default historical CompetitionEntry method. Do not infer modern registration.
